children: has acquired Tailwind Labs, the company that developed Tailwind CSS, an open-source, utility-first, cascading style sheet (CSS) framework used to style modern websites directly within HTML.
“We’re joining Shopify to give Tailwind a stable long-term home where it will be actively maintained for the millions of people who depend on it,” said Tailwind creator Adam Wathan.

“Shopify provides an incredible surface area for us to do this work,” Wathan added, referencing Tailwind’s utility to design and host custom storefronts, and manage sales and inventory in a “powerful admin area.”
“Shopify is also on the frontier of where user interfaces need to go next with their explorations into agentic commerce.”
The acquisition will not change Tailwind Labs’ open-source projects and will remain MIT-licensed. Teams will continue to lead and maintain these projects with the support of Shopify

Wathan confirmed that he will no longer try to grow the business around Tailwind, but all existing customers will maintain their access to Tailwind Plus and ui.sh. However, all new sign-ups will be closed in order to focus on Tailwind CSS at Shopify.
Financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

title: Shopify acquires Tailwind Labs
